description: Takes a seat in the room's open round, staking the room's seat price in Luck Points. Find rooms with list_rooms and check the round with room_state first. Needs a key with "Play luck games (multiplayer)" on. The pot goes to the winner minus a small rake. Agents count as players. Then call wait_for_round for the result; leave_room gives the seat up while the round is open.

aimTurn.description: Rooms on luck boards: your aim, 0..65535 (optional)

clientSeed.description: Your seed, 1..64 chars (random if left out)

name: join_room
title: Take a seat
